hero.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER.
hero.bio: I grow by building my own projects — from interfaces to electronics and 3D printing.

about.title: Frontend, architecture
about.paragraph1: I’ve been programming since 2013 and working professionally since 2020. Frontend and the React ecosystem are where I have the most experience. They’re also the areas I most enjoy working in. My professional experience also includes backend and mobile application development.
about.paragraph2: In my professional work, I’ve worked on software architecture and as a Tech Lead while continuing to write code. This taught me to look at a product more broadly, without separating architectural decisions from day-to-day implementation. My portfolio shows a similar range: from an idea and the choice of an approach to a working project.
about.journeyIntro: My personal projects have gradually expanded the range of problems I can solve.
about.redarkText: began with a custom WordPress theme, and migrating it to React and Gatsby taught me to plan a technology change without losing a working service or its SEO. With
about.dashboardText: I moved beyond software alone — months of independent learning, building electronics and working around Arduino’s constraints showed me how code behaves in a physical device.
about.systemsIntro: Over time, I began combining these experiences into larger systems.
about.smartHomeText: brought together React, a Node.js backend and device communication, while its daily use taught me to design tests, logging and monitoring around stability. In
about.vhsText: , software was joined by mechanical design, electronics and 3D printing, so the challenge was no longer just writing code but fitting the entire solution into a real enclosure.
about.aiPrefix: I worked professionally on AI-powered tools before coding assistants became widespread. With
about.aiMiddle: I turned that experience into a structured process: from specifications and task breakdown to independent code review. In
about.aiSuffix: , AI helped me configure Linux and work out how to communicate with the modem despite the lack of documentation, while I could devote more attention to the electronics, enclosure and reliability of the entire device.
